review_scope: Technical comparison of 23 paired composed physical views after the resident-roster save migration. The archived-campaign round trip, save corruption controls and temporal-loop checks are recorded separately.

Case glass, lower wood and the door beyond retain their finish and profile.
Tile courses and the cistern fit match under the same camera angle.
The sampled dark brick remains continuous. The moving carriage sits outside the view.
Table, floor, wood trim and furnishings retain placement as the companion animates.
The fabric edge, wall tile and lamp pool retain the same coverage.
Window, radiator and furniture match. The resident and companion vary slightly in pose.
The visible window and furnishings retain their arrangement and material boundaries.
The counter, upper cabinet and lit portion of wall are still readable.
The hinge, fuse bank and conduit match. The reflection changes the open leaf from dark brown to slate.
The floor tile, foreground edges and brass line retain the same low-light coverage.
The shelf, portrait and red foreground detail retain their outline.
The beam and distant wall shelves retain their layout. The warm light at right varies slightly.
The brass doors, lower bench and dark wall panel retain their positions.
Radiator ribs, curtain and table retain their arrangement at the same viewing angle.
Landing, rail and fittings retain their silhouette through small shadow differences.
Tank, supports and roof skyline retain the same profile.
Terminal, board and wood floor remain clear in the paired frames.
Tile, cistern outline and cover fit match with slightly different shadows.
The colored residue and illuminated rails are visible. The companion varies slightly in pose.

Crumbs, mapped counter and adjacent kitchen stock remain visible. Ambient insects vary across frames.
The case, dial and mapped dark wall retain their placement.
